summary: Both halves inspected, with enlargements of the separator in(9), the lowered o in Hotab, normalization and the marks above equivalence. The initial integrat or really contains an extra space. The round symbol after Delta remains uncertain; its oval and interior curve are visible but not assigned a category name. The right-edge closing parenthesis is pen. The separator in(9) is a pen semicolon. The cancelled prose is readable, whereas both cancelled formula fragments remain illegible. The margin explicitly weakens having a final object to1-connectedness. The author hopes for equivalence only after localization and says the unnormalized model functor is not itself an equivalence.
